score_notes.A: Coherent arc (intro+timeline, six lineage sections, two cross-cutting sections, synthesis, outlook, conclusion), noun-phrase headings, valid front matter. Deductions: sections hollowed by sentence removal (L714-722 iterative GRPO is one sentence after the figure; L724-726 '도메인 밖으로도 번진 향상과 남은 약점' is two sentences and never mentions out-of-domain gains; L728-742 begins its key paragraph with a dangling ' 저자들은 이를'), paragraphs starting with a stray space (L722, L736), a trailing '\\' inside $$ (L397), '|' used for conditionals in math (L466, L472, L578: 'y|x'), and 94k body characters with 41 figures, far more than a reader needs.
score_notes.B: Mostly natural '입니다' Korean. Deductions: text about the pipeline's own evidence leaks into the prose (L652 '인용한 표 행만으로는 ... 확인되지 않습니다', L261 '여기서 다룬 결과만으로는 특정되지 않습니다', L782 '여기 인용한 결과만으로는 드러나지 않으며', L876 '격차가 몇 %p인지는 여기서 옮기지 않습니다'); filler (L281 '요약 과제의 구체적인 승률은 아래에서 다룹니다.'); a colloquial word (L367 '관전 포인트'); a stammer (L81 '예를 들어 가상의 프롬프트 ... 합시다. 예를 들어 가상의 보상 모델이 ... 합시다'); repeated figure-intro sentences ('~에 주목하면 됩니다' L453, '~을 보면 됩니다' L177, '눈여겨볼 곳은' L650); '이 글의 판단/관점' 8 times; English in table settings (L835 '5k offline vs mock', L849 'Iter3', L839 'RM 12M 등').
score_notes.C: Removed sentences leave references to nothing: L736 '저자들은 이를' and L737 '그 정답' (the Maj@K/Pass@K result sentence was removed); L742 '이런 영역에서는 RL보다 데이터나 사전학습이 먼저 바뀌어야 합니다' follows a sentence about the opposite case; L543 '요구한 간격에 못 미치므로' when γ is never given; L541 '세 배가 됩니다' after the sum/mean computation was removed. L814 puts RRHF in 'this lineage' (DPO) although the post files it under reference-free losses. The running example's prompt changes at L81 ('백신은 어떻게 면역을 만드나요?') from the L24 version. The synthesis sections (L806-830, L853-888) re-narrate the cards instead of comparing lineages.
score_notes.D: Hard steps get worked numbers: BT loss (L81), KL penalty (L115), the Gao peak at d=α/2β (L225), DPO loss and gradient weight (L323-325), IPO σ(0.5/τ) at τ=1 and 0.1 (L361), SPPO's −1/2 derivation (L609). Deductions: the SimPO and GRPO worked examples were truncated into fragments (L541-543, L684), and easy points are re-explained several times (Maj@K/Pass@K defined at L730, L824 and L886; SimPO length normalization at L26, L788, L800, L816 and L876).
score_notes.E: Equations sit where they are discussed, and figures are described in words rather than by number. Deductions: 41 figures, several with no takeaway (Atari L91, iterative GRPO L718, Maj@K/Pass@K L732, whose finding was deleted); comparison-table defects (see extras); 4 of 22 papers missing from the table (Llama 2, Online IPO, DAA overoptimization, GRPO Dynamics); the body repeats most of the table's numbers.
score_notes.F: One wrong attribution repeated across the post: DeepSeekMath's GRPO is said to use a correctness (0/1) verifiable reward (L874, L824 '첫째, 정답을 판정할 수 있는 검증 가능한 보상이 있어야 합니다', L662, L674 heading), but DeepSeekMath scores outputs with a trained reward model (Table 10: GRPO reward function 'Model'; §4.1.2 'A reward model is then used to score the outputs'). The binary reward is Mroueh's (2503.06639) analysis assumption. One unsupported table setting: L836 '1.3B RLHF vs 12B? SFT' (the paper says 'a supervised model 10× its size'). L652 says the table gives no grounds to attribute the gap to iterative relabeling, while the paper labels the row 'Ours (DPO baseline)', 8B, and says 'This demonstrates the advantage of online iterative RLHF'. Every other number sampled matched.

claim_headings.evidence: All H2/H3 are noun phrases carrying a claim, e.g. L201 '프록시를 세게 밀수록 꺾이는 실제 품질', L744 '보상 모델 없이도 되살아나는 굿하트의 혹 모양 곡선'; no 다-form headings (grep for '^#.*다$' finds none). L724's claim ('도메인 밖으로도 번진 향상') is not borne out by its body.

running_example.evidence: The vaccine prompt with y_w/y_l is set up at L24 and reused in every lineage (L115, L165, L267, L321, L345, L401, L445, L541, L569, L624, L650, L750, L796, L865, L894); the arithmetic problem stands in for GRPO (L28, L684). Minor drift: L81 uses a different prompt.

mechanism_design_formula_example.evidence: Complete for Ziegler KL (L111-115), DPO (L297-327), IPO (L343-383) and Gao (L211-225). The SimPO (L541-543) and GRPO (L684) worked examples were truncated.

length_fitted.evidence: About 94,000 body characters and 41 figures; long figure-by-figure walk-throughs in the RLHF section (L57-239) and repeated synthesis (L806-898).

type_specific_shape.evidence: Survey numbers are not owned by one table: the body states nearly every table number first (L147/L836 61%/43%; L177/L837 85±3%; L183/L837 69.6%; L283/L843; L337/L842; L421-423/L846; L499/L848; L553/L851; L632/L849; L652/L850; L726/L847). The synthesis sections re-tell the cards (L812-824).

L129 says only that the copying model 'may be exploiting the fact that labelers rely on simple heuristics', matching 1909.08593 §1; the 96%/84% (L835) are not attributed to it.
No sentence claims 2406.02900 gives no quantitative figures; L766 even cites its RMSE result.

The main comparison table (L832-851) has no reward column, but the method framework table gives GRPO's reward function as L874 '정답 여부(0/1)', and L824 makes a verifiable reward a requirement of GRPO. DeepSeekMath's GRPO uses a trained reward model with group-normalized per-output rewards.
No 다-form headings; the overoptimization section is L744 '## 보상 모델 없이도 되살아나는 굿하트의 혹 모양 곡선'.

extras.S1_cards_and_table: Limitations are the papers' own (e.g. L842 '6B 규모 한정 평가', L846 '저노이즈 선호 데이터에서 과소적합 위험'). Deductions: English setting words in cells and body re-explanations (see facts_once).

top_issues: DeepSeekMath's GRPO is presented as a verifiable 0/1 correctness reward method (L874 framework table, L824, L662, L674 heading); the paper scores outputs with a trained reward model (Table 10: reward function 'Model'). The binary reward is Mroueh's analysis assumption. This repeats checklist item grpo-row-reward.

Sentence removal left the GRPO sections broken: L736 '저자들은 이를' and L742 '이런 영역에서는' refer to deleted sentences; L724-726 is a two-sentence section whose heading claim (out-of-domain gains) is gone; the L541-543 SimPO example lost its arithmetic and γ. The removed Maj@K/Pass@K sentence was in fact supported (temperature 0.7 is in Figure 7's caption).

The survey rule that numbers live in one table is not met: nearly every table number is first stated in the body (L147, L177, L183, L283, L337, L421-423, L499, L553, L632, L652, L726). The synthesis sections (L806-830, L853-888) re-tell the cards, and the same facts recur three or four times.

Comparison-table defects: garbled '12B?' (L836), a '-' limitation and number-free results (L838, L840), a duplicated IPO result (L844), a bound instead of a result (L845), English setting words, and 4 of 22 papers missing.

Text about the pipeline's own evidence leaks into the prose and partly contradicts sources: L652 says the cited table gives no grounds for attributing the iterative-DPO gap, while the paper labels the row 'Ours (DPO baseline)', 8B, and claims the advantage; similar asides at L261, L782 and L876. The post is also far too long for its job (about 94k characters, 41 figures).
